work_item: B04 source-preserving named-column CSV descriptive statistics
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: Tests and the normal CLI route were not executed in this implementation pass; formatting, compilation, Clippy and build checks were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvStatistics -> document::csv_statistics -> math::summarize
supported_behavior_from_source: Exact decoded named-header selection over source-preserving RFC-style CSV.
Unitless cells are passed to the exact scalar/statistics path; all-unit cells must be exact decimal numeric literals with units.
Mixed unit-bearing and unitless cells return CSV_STATISTICS_MIXED_VALUES before an artifact is stored.

Successful reports include the CSV body digest, exact column/index, exact descriptive statistics and original header/cell byte spans; Core stores the full DocumentResult artifact and returns its digest dependency.
